name: spill-tools
description: External spill consumer: exposes the spill@1 capability as the tools 'spill write', 'spill read', 'spill info', 'spill list', 'spill purge' and 'spill policy' - provider agnostic, no backend named

config.description: The consumer only shapes the tools it registers; the spill directory, the payload ceiling and the retention policy belong to the provider's row.

pageBytes.description: Byte window the 'spill read' tool uses when the call names none (the provider's own default and cap still apply).
